Thanks for chatting with our widget a few minutes ago — really appreciate the quick context on your use case (web scraping + downstream search). Happy to get a short demo and map our latency/cost expectations to a quick proof-of-concept.

I pulled a couple of 30-minute windows that are intentionally friendly to East Africa Time (EAT, UTC+3) since you noted your team is there. If any of these work, I can lock in the slot and include our AE (Marissa) and a short mutual action plan.

Proposed 30m windows (all in EAT):
- Tue 10 Nov, 15:00–15:30 EAT
- Wed 11 Nov, 09:00–09:30 EAT
- Thu 12 Nov, 11:00–11:30 EAT (fallback)

If none of those fit, feel free to pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min — I set availability to include at least one EAT-friendly block per day.

What I plan to cover in the 30m: a quick walkthrough of the hosted API latency profile, how Dedicated pools can reduce unit cost for heavy scraping workloads, and an ops checklist for onboarding.

Attachments: BrightData_RWI_MAP_v1.pdf (short Mutual Action Plan / next steps template)

Best,
